dog.description_text:
Tigger is a happy, lovable boy from Mississippi who is ready to bounce his way right into your heart. Full of personality and affection, Tigger has remained incredibly sweet despite an uncertain past. He loves attention, companionship, and being around people who make him feel safe and loved. Tigger is searching for a forever home where he can finally relax, play, and enjoy the life every dog deserves.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
